name: skill-mcp
description: Serves a directory of Agent Skills over MCP — list them, load their instructions, read their bundled files, and run only the scripts a skill declares

skills_dir.title: Skills directory
skills_dir.description: Directory holding your skills (a directory of <name>/SKILL.md, or one skill's own directory). Several may be given, separated by ':'. Leave blank to serve the example skill bundled with this server.

tools.name: skill_list
tools.description: List every skill found, with its description, file count and the exact scripts that may be run

tools.name: skill_load
tools.description: Load one skill's SKILL.md instructions verbatim, plus a manifest of its bundled files

tools.name: skill_file
tools.description: Read one file a skill bundles, resolved inside that skill's own directory

tools.name: skill_run
tools.description: Execute a script the skill declares as runnable, with an argument array
